title: Bauhaus Geometry
description: Design graphique vectoriel minimaliste inspiré des mouvements Bauhaus et De Stijl. Il présente des primitives géométriques planes et sans ombres qui s'entrecroisent avec des bords nets.
description_en: Minimalist vector graphic design inspired by the Bauhaus and De Stijl movements. It features flat, unshaded geometric primitives intersecting cleanly with razor-sharp edges.
description_fr: Design graphique vectoriel minimaliste inspiré des mouvements Bauhaus et De Stijl. Il présente des primitives géométriques planes et sans ombres qui s'entrecroisent avec des bords nets.
prompt: Flat vector graphic design, Bauhaus geometric abstraction. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Construct the scene entirely from strict, unshaded geometric primitives—circles, squares, triangles, intersecting rectangles. Razor-sharp vector-cut edges, 2D orthographic projection, absolute zero depth. Employ a bold, high-contrast color palette utilizing {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}}, anchored by stark black structural lines and pure white negative spaces. Apply solid, uniform color fills exclusively; strictly avoid gradients, volumetric shading, specular highlights, or cast shadows. Objects overlap in a pure 2D hierarchy, mimicking cut-paper collage or mid-century modernist screen-printing. Linework, when present, consists of thick, uniform black strokes delineating structural boundaries. The overall composition must feel highly structured, mathematical, and starkly minimalist.
